# Simple English Wikipedia

> > A free encyclopedia written in Simple English, covering topics from world geography and history to notable people and cultural subjects.

Simple English Wikipedia uses basic vocabulary and simpler grammar to make knowledge accessible to English learners, children, and people with learning disabilities. Articles cover a wide range of subjects including French communes, historical figures, archaeological sites, and cultural topics from around the world.

## Key Topics

- French communes and geography
- France administrative divisions
- Bourgogne-Franche-Comté region
- Allier department
- Doubs department
- Pays de la Loire
- Norwegian municipalities
- Political biographies
- Historical figures
- European geography
- Archaeological sites
- Cultural heritage
- Engineering education
- Contemporary politics

## Notable People and Political Figures

- [Éamon de Valera](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89amon_de_Valera): Irish President and Taoiseach, Fianna Fáil leader in 20th century Ireland
- [Éric Zemmour](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89ric_Zemmour): French far-right politician, Reconquête founder, 2022 presidential candidate
- [Óscar Humberto Mejía Victores](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%93scar_Humberto_Mej%C3%ADa_Victores): Guatemalan military leader and president after 1983 coup d'état
- [Éric Boullier](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89ric_Boullier): French Formula One team principal and McLaren racing executive
- [Ömer İzgi](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%96mer_%C4%B0zgi): Turkish politician, Grand National Assembly speaker from Konya
- [Édika](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89dika): French comics artist Édouard Karali, born in Cairo, died Rochefort-du-Gard

## History and Archaeology

- [Çatalhöyük](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%87atalh%C3%B6y%C3%BCk): UNESCO World Heritage Neolithic settlement in Anatolia, Turkey

## European Regions and Cities

- [Åland Islands](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%85land_Islands): Autonomous Swedish-speaking region of Finland with capital Mariehamn
- [Évreux](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89vreux): Prefecture of Eure department in Normandy, France on River Iton
- [Ål](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%85l): Norwegian municipality in Buskerud county, Hallingdal district

## Education and Culture

- [École Centrale de Lille](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89cole_Centrale_de_Lille): French Grande École engineering school in Villeneuve-d'Ascq, Lille
- [École nationale supérieure d'informatique pour l'industrie et l'entreprise](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89cole_nationale_sup%C3%A9rieure_d%27informatique_pour_l%27industrie_et_l%27entreprise): ENSIIE French computer science engineering school in Évry and Strasbourg
- [Éclair](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89clair): French pastry dessert with cream filling and chocolate topping

## French Communes

- [Écharcon](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89charcon): French commune in Essonne department, Île-de-France region
- [Échassières](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89chassi%C3%A8res): French commune in Allier department, central France
- [Échenans](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89chenans): French commune in Doubs, Bourgogne-Franche-Comté region
- [Échenoz-la-Méline](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89chenoz-la-M%C3%A9line): French commune in Haute-Saône, Bourgogne-Franche-Comté
- [Écommoy](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89commoy): French commune in Sarthe department, Pays de la Loire region
- [Écurcey](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89curcey): French commune in Doubs, Montbéliard arrondissement
- [Étroussat](https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%89troussat): French commune in Allier department, central France municipality
